file_write.scope: Only the user-selected migration output directory and governed package reports; never frozen Android source or YAO engine files.
file_write.reason: The controller must initialize ledgers, issue work orders, anchor evidence, record receipts, and write canonical gate reports.

target_enforcement.openai: workspace permission plus explicit run directory

subprocess.scope: Argument-array invocation of bundled validation scripts and frozen specialist commands only; shell injection is forbidden.
subprocess.reason: Canonical gates and specialist handoffs require deterministic local process execution.

target_enforcement.vscode: workspace trust plus host process policy
